Container.Name: Thomas Timber Dashboard
Container.Overview: Thomas Timber quotations, panelling calculations, material purchasing and pricing. Create the administrator on first visit. Persistent data and a generated session key live in /data. Prepare both host directories writable by UID 99/GID 100 before starting. Back up /data before updates. Stair physical saw conventions remain pending workshop verification.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Database and persistent session key; owner 99:100

Config.Name: Session secret (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty to generate /data/session.key. If overriding, use a stable random value of at least 32 characters; keep it private and backed up.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when accessing through HTTPS; leave 0 for LAN HTTP.
